measures.name: Story | On Track %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), DimProject[OverallHealth_Value] = "(1) On Track" ),
    CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[OverallHealth_Value] ) )
)
measures.description: Share of projects whose overall health is (1) On Track.

measures.name: Story | Refreshed
measures.expression:
VAR _t = MAX ( RefreshTime[Last Refreshed (Belgium Time)] )
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _t ), "POWERED BY ONEPLAN", "POWERED BY ONEPLAN  ·  REFRESHED " & UPPER ( FORMAT ( _t, "dd mmm yyyy hh:nn" ) ) & " CET" )

measures.name: Story | Forecast Variance
measures.expression: [Finance | Forecast Cost] - [Finance | Budget Cost]
measures.description: Forecast cost minus budget cost (FactCost). Positive = forecast over budget.

measures.name: Story | Forecast Variance %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Forecast Variance], [Finance | Budget Cost] )

measures.name: Story | Burn %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Finance | Actual Cost], [Finance | Budget Cost] )
measures.description: Actual cost as a share of budget cost.

measures.name: Story | Projects Over Budget
Story | Variance Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _p = [Story | Forecast Variance %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), "#666666", IF ( _p > 0.05, "#C0392B", IF ( _p > 0, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Burn Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _p = [Story | Burn %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), "#666666", IF ( _p > 1, "#C0392B", IF ( _p > 0.9, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Finance Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _b = [Finance | Budget Cost]
VAR _a = [Finance | Actual Cost]
VAR _f = [Finance | Forecast Cost]
VAR _v = _f - _b
VAR _absv = ABS ( _v )
VAR _n = [Story | Projects Over Budget]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Name] ), "@v", [Finance | Forecast Cost] - [Finance | Budget Cost] ), [@v] > 0 ),
        [@v], DESC )
VAR _tn = MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Name] )
VAR _tv = MAXX ( _top, [@v] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( _b ) && ISBLANK ( _f ),
        "No financial plan data in the current selection.",
        "Budget " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _b ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _b, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & "  ·  actuals " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _a ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _a ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _a / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _a, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _a, _b ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _a, _b ), "0%" ) ) & " burned)  ·  forecast "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _f ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _f ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _f / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _f ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _f / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _f, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & IF ( _v >= 0, "  →  +", "  →  −" ) & IF ( ISBLANK ( _absv ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _absv ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _absv / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _absv ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _absv / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _absv, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " ("
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _v, _b ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _v, _b ), "+0.0%;-0.0%" ) ) & ") versus budget. "
            & IF ( _n > 0,
                FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " project(s) forecast over budget; the largest overrun is " & _tn & " (+" & IF ( ISBLANK ( _tv ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _tv ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _tv / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _tv ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _tv / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _tv, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & ").",
                "No project is forecast over budget." )
    )

measures.name: Story | Proposed Projects
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimProject ), DimProject[State_Value] = "Proposed" ) + 0

measures.name: Story | Aligned Budget %
measures.expression:
DIVIDE (
    CALCULATE ( SUM ( DimProject[Budget] ), DimProject[StrategicAlignment_Value] IN { "Strong", "Extreme" } ),
    SUM ( DimProject[Budget] )
)
measures.description: Share of plan budget in projects rated Strong or Extreme strategic alignment.

measures.name: Story | Plan Budget
measures.expression: SUM ( DimProject[Budget] )
measures.description: Budget field on the project plan (DimProject), not time-phased.

measures.name: Story | Plan Forecast
measures.expression: SUM ( DimProject[Forecast] )

measures.name: Story | Plan Variance %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Plan Forecast] - [Story | Plan Budget], [Story | Plan Budget] )

measures.name: Story | Plan Variance Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _p = [Story | Plan Variance %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _p ), "#666666", IF ( _p > 0.05, "#C0392B", IF ( _p > 0, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Health Colour
measures.expression:
SWITCH ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimProject[OverallHealth_Value] ),
    "(1) On Track", "#1E6D6E",
    "(2) At Risk", "#D9A832",
    "(3) Off Track", "#C0392B",
    "#666666" )

measures.name: Story | Portfolio Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _n = COALESCE ( [Portfolio 360 | Active Projects], 0 )
VAR _p = CALCULATE ( DISTINCTCOUNT ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ), DimProject[Portfolio Name] <> "(No portfolio)" )
VAR _b = [Story | Plan Budget]
VAR _al = [Story | Aligned Budget %]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1, ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ), "@b", CALCULATE ( SUM ( DimProject[Budget] ) ) ), [@b], DESC )
VAR _tn = MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Portfolio Name] )
VAR _tb = MAXX ( _top, [@b] )
VAR _prop = [Story | Proposed Projects]
VAR _ot = [Story | On Track %]
RETURN
    FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " active projects across " & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _p, 0 ), "0" ) & " portfolios carry " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _b ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _b, "#,0" ) ) ) )
        & " of plan budget. " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _al ), "–", FORMAT ( _al, "0%" ) ) & " of that budget sits in Strong/Extreme-aligned work; the largest share goes to "
        & _tn & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _tb, _b ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _tb, _b ), "0%" ) ) & "). " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ot ), "–", FORMAT ( _ot, "0%" ) ) & " of projects report On Track overall and "
        & FORMAT ( _prop, "0" ) & " proposal(s) wait in the pipeline."

measures.name: Story | Util Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _u = [Capacity | Resource Utilization%]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ) || _u = 0, "#9AA3AF", IF ( _u > 1, "#C0392B", IF ( _u >= 0.8, "#1E6D6E", IF ( _u >= 0.5, "#D9A832", "#9AA3AF" ) ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Util Cell Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _u = [Capacity | Resource Utilization%]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ) || _u = 0, "#FFFFFF", IF ( _u > 1, "#F8D0CC", IF ( _u >= 0.8, "#D3EEDB", IF ( _u >= 0.5, "#FBEFD0", "#EEF0F3" ) ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Soft Demand %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Capacity | Forecast], [Capacity | Committed] + [Capacity | Forecast] + [Resource | Scheduled] )
measures.description: Share of planned demand that is still Forecast (not Committed or Scheduled).

measures.name: Story | Resource Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Resource KPI | Total Resources]
VAR _c = [Capacity | Resource Capacity]
VAR _s = [Capacity | Total Hours Scheduled]
VAR _u = DIVIDE ( _s, _c )
VAR _o = COALESCE ( [Capacity | Over-Allocated Resource Count], 0 )
VAR _role =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimResource[Role_Value] ), "@u", [Capacity | Resource Utilization%] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimResource[Role_Value] ) && [@u] > 0 ),
        [@u], DESC )
VAR _rn = TRIM ( MAXX ( _role, DimResource[Role_Value] ) )
VAR _ru = MAXX ( _role, [@u] )
VAR _soft = [Story | Soft Demand %]
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( _c ),
        "No capacity in the current selection — pick a year or department with resource calendars.",
        FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _r, 0 ), "#,0" ) & " people offer " & FORMAT ( _c, "#,0" ) & " h of capacity; " & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _s, 0 ), "#,0" )
            & " h are scheduled  →  " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), "–", FORMAT ( _u, "0%" ) ) & " utilised. " & FORMAT ( _o, "0" )
            & " people are over-allocated (above 100%)"
            & IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( _rn ), "; the most stretched role is " & _rn & " at " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ru ), "–", FORMAT ( _ru, "0%" ) ), "" ) & ". "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _soft ), "–", FORMAT ( _soft, "0%" ) ) & " of demand is still soft forecast — firm it up before committing new work."
    )

measures.name: Story | Milestones Next 30d
measures.expression:
CALCULATE (
    COUNTROWS ( DimTask ),
    DimTask[Milestone] = TRUE (),
    DimTask[PercentDone] < 100,
    DimTask[EndDate] >= TODAY (),
    DimTask[EndDate] < TODAY () + 31
) + 0

measures.name: Story | Project Slip (days)
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX (
    FILTER ( DimProject, NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Summary_EndDate] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( DimProject[Summary_BaselineEndDate] ) ),
    INT ( DimProject[Summary_EndDate] ) - INT ( DimProject[Summary_BaselineEndDate] )
)
measures.description: Average finish date minus baseline finish date, in days (projects with a baseline).

measures.name: Story | Task Slip (days)
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX (
    FILTER ( DimTask, NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[EndDate] ) && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] ) ),
    INT ( DimTask[EndDate] ) - INT ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] )
)

measures.name: Story | Slipped Tasks
measures.expression:
COUNTROWS (
    FILTER ( DimTask,
        DimTask[WorkType] = "Tasks"
            && NOT ISBLANK ( DimTask[BaselineEndDate] )
            && DimTask[EndDate] > DimTask[BaselineEndDate]
            && DimTask[Status] <> "Completed" )
) + 0
measures.description: Open tasks whose current finish is later than their baseline finish.

measures.name: Story | Due Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _d = MAX ( DimTask[EndDate] )
VAR _p = MAX ( DimTask[PercentDone] )
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _d ), "#666666", IF ( _d < TODAY () && _p < 100, "#C0392B", IF ( _d < TODAY () + 14, "#D9A832", "#1F2A44" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Slip Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _d = [Story | Task Slip (days)]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _d ), "#666666", IF ( _d > 20, "#C0392B", IF ( _d > 0, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Schedule Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _ot = [Portfolio 360 | On-Time Delivery %]
VAR _ar = COALESCE ( [Portfolio 360 | At-Risk Count], 0 )
VAR _sl = COALESCE ( [Portfolio 360 | Slipping Count], 0 )
VAR _od = COALESCE ( [Task | Overdue Tasks], 0 )
VAR _ms = [Story | Milestones Next 30d]
VAR _slip = [Story | Project Slip (days)]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Name] ), "@d", [Story | Project Slip (days)] ), [@d] > 0 ),
        [@d], DESC )
RETURN
    IF ( ISBLANK ( _ot ), "–", FORMAT ( _ot, "0%" ) ) & " of projects are on schedule; " & FORMAT ( _ar, "0" ) & " are at risk and " & FORMAT ( _sl, "0" )
        & " are slipping. " & FORMAT ( _od, "#,0" ) & " tasks are overdue and " & FORMAT ( _ms, "0" )
        & " milestone(s) fall due in the next 30 days. "
        & IF ( ISBLANK ( _slip ), "No baselines are set, so slippage cannot be measured yet.",
            "Projects now finish on average " & FORMAT ( _slip, "0" ) & " days " & IF ( _slip >= 0, "later", "earlier" )
                & " than baselined"
                & IF ( COUNTROWS ( _top ) > 0,
                    "; the biggest move is " & MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Name] ) & " (+" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@d] ), "0" ) & " days).",
                    "." ) )

measures.name: Story | Critical High Risks
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( [Project | Active Risks], DimTask[Impact] IN { "(1) Critical", "(2) High" } ) + 0

measures.name: Story | Risk Exposure
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( DimTask[Exposure] ), DimTask[WorkType] = "Risks", DimTask[State] = "Active" )
measures.description: Sum of the Exposure field on active risks.

measures.name: Story | Avg Risk Probability
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( DimTask[Probability] ), DimTask[WorkType] = "Risks", DimTask[State] = "Active" ), 100 )

measures.name: Story | Unmitigated Risk %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( CALCULATE ( [Project | Active Risks], DimTask[RiskStage] = "Identify" ), [Project | Active Risks] )
measures.description: Share of active risks still in the Identify stage (no mitigation started).

measures.name: Story | Active Risk Count
measures.expression: [Project | Active Risks] + 0

measures.name: Story | Heat Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _i = SWITCH ( LEFT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimTask[Impact] ), 3 ), "(1)", 4, "(2)", 3, "(3)", 2, "(4)", 1, 0 )
VAR _p = SWITCH ( LEFT ( SELECTEDVALUE ( DimTask[Probability Category] ), 3 ), "(1)", 4, "(2)", 3, "(3)", 2, "(4)", 1, 0 )
VAR _sc = _i * _p
RETURN IF ( _sc = 0, "#FFFFFF", IF ( _sc >= 12, "#E57368", IF ( _sc >= 6, "#F2B880", IF ( _sc >= 3, "#F7E3A1", "#D3EEDB" ) ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Risk Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _r = COALESCE ( [Project | Active Risks], 0 )
VAR _ch = [Story | Critical High Risks]
VAR _e = [Story | Risk Exposure]
VAR _i = COALESCE ( [Project | Active Issues], 0 )
VAR _u = [Story | Unmitigated Risk %]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Program Name] ), "@e", [Story | Risk Exposure] ), [@e] > 0 ),
        [@e], DESC )
RETURN
    FORMAT ( _r, "0" ) & " active risks (" & FORMAT ( _ch, "0" ) & " critical or high) carry " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _e ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _e ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _e / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _e ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _e / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _e, "#,0" ) ) ) )
        & " of exposure, and " & FORMAT ( _i, "0" ) & " issue(s) are open. "
        & IF ( COUNTROWS ( _top ) > 0,
            "Exposure is concentrated in " & MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Program Name] ) & " ("
                & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( _top, [@e] ), _e ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( MAXX ( _top, [@e] ), _e ), "0%" ) ) & "). ", "" )
        & IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), "–", FORMAT ( _u, "0%" ) ) & " of risks are still at 'Identify' with no mitigation started."

measures.name: Story | Benefit Cost Ratio
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Benefits | Planned Benefits], [Story | Plan Budget] )
measures.description: Planned benefits divided by plan budget.

measures.name: Story | Ratio Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _r = [Story | Benefit Cost Ratio]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _r ), "#666666", IF ( _r >= 2, "#1E6D6E", IF ( _r >= 1, "#D9A832", "#C0392B" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Benefits Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _b = [Benefits | Planned Benefits]
VAR _c = [Story | Plan Budget]
VAR _r = [Benefits | Realized Benefits]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Name] ), "@x", [Story | Benefit Cost Ratio] ), [@x] > 0 ),
        [@x], DESC )
VAR _neg = COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Id] ), [Story | Plan Budget] > 0 && COALESCE ( [Benefits | Planned Benefits], 0 ) = 0 ) )
RETURN
    IF ( COALESCE ( _b, 0 ) = 0,
        "No benefits are recorded on the plans in this selection — capture expected benefits in OnePlan to tell the value story.",
        "The selection plans " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _b ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _b ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _b / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _b, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " of benefits on " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _c ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _c ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _c / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _c ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _c / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _c, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " of budget ("
            & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _b, _c ), "0.0" ) & "× return). Pro-rata on progress, " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _r ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _r ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _r / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _r ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _r / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _r, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " ("
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _r, _b ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _r, _b ), "0%" ) ) & ") is realised so far. Best value for money: " & MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Name] )
            & " (" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@x] ), "0.0" ) & "×). " & FORMAT ( COALESCE ( _neg, 0 ), "0" )
            & " funded project(s) have no benefit recorded."
    )

measures.name: Story | Exec Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _n = COALESCE ( [Portfolio 360 | Active Projects], 0 )
VAR _ot = [Story | On Track %]
VAR _vp = [Story | Forecast Variance %]
VAR _u = [Capacity | Resource Utilization%]
VAR _o = COALESCE ( [Capacity | Over-Allocated Resource Count], 0 )
VAR _ch = [Story | Critical High Risks]
VAR _focus =
    SWITCH ( TRUE (),
        _vp > 0.05, "cost overrun",
        _o > 0 && _u > 1, "resource overload",
        _ot < 0.7, "delivery health",
        _ch > 5, "risk exposure",
        "keeping the course" )
RETURN
    FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " active projects, " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _ot ), "–", FORMAT ( _ot, "0%" ) ) & " on track. Forecast is "
        & IF ( ISBLANK ( _vp ), "–", FORMAT ( _vp, "+0.0%;-0.0%;0.0%" ) ) & " versus budget, people are " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _u ), "–", FORMAT ( _u, "0%" ) ) & " utilised ("
        & FORMAT ( _o, "0" ) & " over-allocated) and " & FORMAT ( _ch, "0" )
        & " critical/high risks are open. This month's focus: " & _focus & "."

measures.name: Story | Exec Action Money
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Story | Projects Over Budget]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimProject[Name] ), "@v", [Story | Forecast Variance] ), [@v] > 0 ),
        [@v], DESC )
RETURN
    IF ( _n > 0,
        "1 · Money — review the " & FORMAT ( _n, "0" ) & " project(s) forecast over budget — start with " & MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Name] )
            & " (+" & IF ( ISBLANK ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) ), "–", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ) / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _top, [@v] ), "#,0" ) ) ) ) & ").",
        "1 · Money — spend is within budget on every project — protect the contingency and release unused budget." )

measures.name: Story | Exec Action People
measures.expression:
VAR _o = COALESCE ( [Capacity | Over-Allocated Resource Count], 0 )
VAR _role =
    TOPN ( 1,
        FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( DimResource[Role_Value] ), "@u", [Capacity | Resource Utilization%] ),
            NOT ISBLANK ( DimResource[Role_Value] ) && [@u] > 0 ),
        [@u], DESC )
RETURN
    IF ( _o > 0,
        "2 · People — rebalance " & FORMAT ( _o, "0" ) & " over-allocated people; the most stretched role is "
            & TRIM ( MAXX ( _role, DimResource[Role_Value] ) ) & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( MAXX ( _role, [@u] ) ), "–", FORMAT ( MAXX ( _role, [@u] ), "0%" ) ) & ").",
        "2 · People — nobody is over-allocated — there is room to pull work forward from the pipeline." )

measures.name: Story | Exec Action Risk
measures.expression:
VAR _ch = [Story | Critical High Risks]
VAR _od = COALESCE ( [Task | Overdue Tasks], 0 )
RETURN
    IF ( _ch > 0,
        "3 · Risk — escalate " & FORMAT ( _ch, "0" ) & " critical/high risk(s) to their owners and clear " & FORMAT ( _od, "#,0" ) & " overdue task(s).",
        "3 · Risk — no critical or high risk is open — " & FORMAT ( _od, "#,0" ) & " overdue task(s) remain to clear." )

measures.name: Story | Overrun
measures.expression: SUMX ( VALUES ( DimProject[Name] ), VAR _v = [Story | Forecast Variance] RETURN IF ( _v > 0, _v ) )
measures.description: Sum of positive project overruns (forecast above budget); underruns do not net them off.

measures.name: Story | Spend Cum %
measures.expression:
VAR _cur = [Finance | Forecast Cost]
VAR _t = ADDCOLUMNS ( ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ), "@c", [Finance | Forecast Cost] )
VAR _all = SUMX ( _t, [@c] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISINSCOPE ( DimProject[Name] ) && _cur > 0, DIVIDE ( SUMX ( FILTER ( _t, [@c] >= _cur ), [@c] ), _all ) )
measures.description: Pareto line: cumulative share of forecast cost, projects ranked from largest to smallest.

measures.name: Story | Overrun Cum %
measures.expression:
VAR _cur = [Story | Overrun]
VAR _t = ADDCOLUMNS ( ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ), "@c", [Story | Overrun] )
VAR _all = SUMX ( _t, [@c] )
RETURN
    IF ( ISINSCOPE ( DimProject[Name] ) && _cur > 0, DIVIDE ( SUMX ( FILTER ( _t, [@c] >= _cur ), [@c] ), _all ) )

measures.name: Story | Spend Share
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Finance | Forecast Cost], CALCULATE ( [Finance | Forecast Cost], ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Pareto Class
measures.expression:
VAR _cum = [Story | Spend Cum %]
VAR _prev = _cum - [Story | Spend Share]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _cum ), BLANK (), IF ( _prev < 0.8, "A · top 80%", IF ( _prev < 0.95, "B · next 15%", "C · tail 5%" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Pareto Class Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _c = LEFT ( [Story | Pareto Class], 1 )
RETURN SWITCH ( _c, "A", "#E8612A", "B", "#1F2A44", "C", "#9AA3AF", "#666666" )

measures.name: Story | Projects For 80% Spend
measures.expression:
VAR _t = FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ), "@c", [Finance | Forecast Cost] ), [@c] > 0 )
VAR _all = SUMX ( _t, [@c] )
VAR _r = ADDCOLUMNS ( _t, "@prev", VAR _x = [@c] RETURN SUMX ( FILTER ( _t, [@c] > _x ), [@c] ) )
RETURN COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( _r, [@prev] < 0.8 * _all ) ) + 0
measures.description: How many of the largest projects together make up 80% of forecast cost.

measures.name: Story | Projects With Spend
measures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ), [Finance | Forecast Cost] > 0 ) ) + 0

measures.name: Story | Concentration %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Projects For 80% Spend], [Story | Projects With Spend] )
measures.description: Share of projects that make up 80% of forecast cost (lower = more concentrated).

measures.name: Story | Top3 Overrun Share
measures.expression:
VAR _t = ADDCOLUMNS ( ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ), "@o", [Story | Overrun] )
RETURN DIVIDE ( SUMX ( TOPN ( 3, _t, [@o], DESC ), [@o] ), SUMX ( _t, [@o] ) )

measures.name: Story | Plan Revenue
measures.expression: SUM ( DimProject[EstimatedRevenue] )
measures.description: Estimated revenue recorded on the plan.

measures.name: Story | Total Value
measures.expression: COALESCE ( [Story | Plan Revenue], 0 ) + COALESCE ( [Benefits | Planned Benefits], 0 )
measures.description: Revenue plus planned benefits: everything the plan promises back.

measures.name: Story | Net Value
measures.expression: [Story | Total Value] - COALESCE ( [Story | Plan Forecast], 0 )
measures.description: Total value minus forecast cost at completion (plan fields, lifetime).

measures.name: Story | Net Margin %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Net Value], [Story | Total Value] )

measures.name: Story | Net ROI
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Story | Net Value], [Story | Plan Forecast] )
measures.description: Net value as a share of forecast cost.

measures.name: Story | Net Colour
measures.expression:
VAR _n = [Story | Net Value]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( _n ), "#666666", IF ( _n < 0, "#C0392B", IF ( [Story | Net Margin %] < 0.2, "#D9A832", "#1E6D6E" ) ) )

measures.name: Story | Pareto PnL Headline
measures.expression:
VAR _k = [Story | Projects For 80% Spend]
VAR _m = [Story | Projects With Spend]
VAR _top =
    TOPN ( 1, ADDCOLUMNS ( ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ), "@c", [Finance | Forecast Cost] ), [@c], DESC )
VAR _tshare = DIVIDE ( MAXX ( _top, [@c] ), CALCULATE ( [Finance | Forecast Cost], ALLSELECTED ( DimProject[Name] ) ) )
VAR _o = [Story | Overrun]
VAR _o3 = [Story | Top3 Overrun Share]
VAR _v = [Story | Total Value]
VAR _c = [Story | Plan Forecast]
VAR _n = [Story | Net Value]
VAR _p =
    ADDCOLUMNS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( DimProject[Portfolio Name] ), DimProject[Portfolio Name] <> "(No portfolio)" ),
        "@n", [Story | Net Value] )
VAR _best = TOPN ( 1, _p, [@n], DESC )
VAR _worst = TOPN ( 1, _p, [@n], ASC )
RETURN
    IF ( _m = 0, "No forecast cost in the current selection.",
        FORMAT ( _k, "0" ) & " of " & FORMAT ( _m, "0" ) & " projects (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _k, _m ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _k, _m ), "0%" ) )
            & ") drive 80% of forecast spend; the largest, " & MAXX ( _top, DimProject[Name] ) & ", alone takes "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _tshare ), "–", FORMAT ( _tshare, "0%" ) ) & ". "
            & IF ( COALESCE ( _o, 0 ) > 0,
                "Overruns total " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _o ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _o ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _o / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _o ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _o / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _o, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " and the top 3 projects carry " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _o3 ), "–", FORMAT ( _o3, "0%" ) ) & " of it. ",
                "No project is forecast over budget. " )
            & "Lifetime P&L: value " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _v ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _v ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _v / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _v ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _v / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _v, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " against forecast cost " & IF ( ISBLANK ( _c ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _c ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _c / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _c ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _c / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _c, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & "  →  net "
            & IF ( ISBLANK ( _n ), "–", IF ( ABS ( _n ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( _n / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( _n ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( _n / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( _n, "#,0" ) ) ) ) & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( DIVIDE ( _n, _v ) ), "–", FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( _n, _v ), "0%" ) ) & " margin)"
            & IF ( COUNTROWS ( _best ) > 0,
                "; strongest portfolio " & MAXX ( _best, DimProject[Portfolio Name] ) & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( MAXX ( _best, [@n] ) ), "–", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _best, [@n] ) ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _best, [@n] ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _best, [@n] ) ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _best, [@n] ) / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _best, [@n] ), "#,0" ) ) ) )
                    & "), weakest " & MAXX ( _worst, DimProject[Portfolio Name] ) & " (" & IF ( ISBLANK ( MAXX ( _worst, [@n] ) ), "–", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _worst, [@n] ) ) >= 1000000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _worst, [@n] ) / 1000000, "#,0.0" ) & "M", IF ( ABS ( MAXX ( _worst, [@n] ) ) >= 1000, "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _worst, [@n] ) / 1000, "#,0" ) & "K", "€" & FORMAT ( MAXX ( _worst, [@n] ), "#,0" ) ) ) ) & ").",
                "." )
    )
